intro.html: This walkthrough is Checkpoint 1 of BookEx 0: Setup Check, your first graded assignment (due Sunday, August 23). First time here outside Start Here? Run through the full Start Here checklist before you tackle this one: Python install, VS Code setup, AI autocomplete off, workspace folder. This page assumes all of that is done. The complete assignment, including Checkpoint 2 (a short program typed from your textbook), lives on the BookEx 0 assignment sheet.

outro.html: When you’re done, head back to Start Here to finish the remaining checkpoints, or jump to Module 1 for your first real lab.
